back_translation: O LORD, You are righteous, even when I bring my case to contend with You; yet I would still lay before You matters of justice. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the treacherous live at ease?
You planted them, and they took root; they grow and bear fruit. You are near in their lips, but far from the depths of their hearts.
O LORD, but You know me; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag them away like a flock of sheep to be slaughtered, and set them apart for the day of execution.

How long will the land mourn, and the grass of every field wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it, the wild animals and the birds are swept away, for they say, 'He will not see our latter end.'
If you have raced with men on foot and are worn out, how will you compete with horses? And if you feel safe only in a peaceful land, what will you do in the dense thickets along the Jordan River?
For even your brothers and your father's household—even they have betrayed you; even they have cried aloud after you. Do not trust them, though they speak well to you.
I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance; I have given the beloved of My heart into the grip of her enemies.
My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest; she roars against Me; therefore I hate her.
Is My inheritance to Me like a bird of prey of strange coloring, that flocks of birds of prey surround and attack her? Go, gather all the wild beasts; bring them to devour her.
Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My portion of land, and have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wilderness.
They have made it a desolation; desolate, it mourns before Me; the whole land has been laid waste, because no one takes it to heart.
Destroyers have come over all the bare heights in the wilderness, for the sword of the LORD is devouring from one end of the land to the other; no human has peace at all.
They have sown wheat but harvested thorns; they have toiled to exhaustion but gained nothing. Be ashamed of your produce, because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

Thus says the LORD: 'Concerning all My evil neighbors who lay hands on the inheritance that I gave My people Israel to possess: Behold, I will uproot them from their land, and I will also uproot the house of Judah from among them.'
And it will come about, after I have uprooted them, I will again have compassion on them, and will bring them back, each to his inheritance and each to his land.

And it will come about, if they will diligently learn the ways of My people, to swear by My name, 'As the LORD lives,' just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal, then they will be established in the midst of My people.
But if they will not obey, then I will uproot that nation, uprooting it utterly and destroying it, declares the LORD.
